name: SPT-CL J1257-2926 (Hubble)
blurb: SPT-CL J1257-2926, a galaxy cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: sptclj12572926-hubble
story: A massive gathering of galaxies picked out by the SPT survey, this cluster is one of 293 that Hubble set out to photograph to build a legacy of massive clusters.

claims.text: SPT-CLJ1257-2926 is a target of Hubble program 15307, which images SPT galaxy clusters
The program's clusters were selected from the SPT cluster catalog, identified via the Sunyaev-Zel'dovich effect
Hubble set out to image 293 SPT galaxy clusters
The program aims to build an SPT-HST legacy of massive clusters
